messages:
jordan: Quick Q — can we do an ad-hoc export of audit logs as CSV with columns timestamp,user,action,resource,ip,change_summary? Need last 90d for a legal request. Who can run this and what are retention rules? cc @marta

marta: We have an export API but by default we redact PII (emails, IPs) unless there's an approved exception. For ad-hoc exports the flow is: create SEC-EXP ticket -> security approval -> infra grants one-time access. Retention: primary store 365d, hosted customer default 90d, and long-term archived per contract.

sam: infra note: CLI exists `redwoodctl audit export` but it's restricted to group `audit-exporters`. Example:

```bash
# example export
redwoodctl audit export \
  --start 2026-01-01 \
  --end 2026-03-01 \
  --format csv \
  --columns "timestamp,user,action,resource,ip,change_summary" \
  > export.csv
```

sam: That CLI will still return `[REDACTED]` for IPs unless security toggles unredacted scope.

marta: Important: to get unredacted fields we need a documented justification in the SEC-EXP ticket and an approver from Legal + Security. We also add an audit trail of who downloaded the export.

olivia: I'll add this flow and the CLI example to the runbook at https://internal.redwood.com/runbooks/audit-exports and include the checklist (Jira template, approver groups, storage location).

audit-bot: Export job queued by jordan. job id: 0x7a9f, ETA ~2m. (automated)

jordan: Thanks. Can we get a tiny CSV sample showing redacted vs non-redacted rows so legal can see format?

marta: sample rows (note: one row kept unredacted for demo after approval):

```csv
timestamp,user,action,resource,ip,change_summary
2026-02-15T12:03:22Z,jane.doe@redwood.com,modify,model-service:v2,[REDACTED],updated timeout=250ms
2026-02-16T09:12:01Z,service-bot,deploy,infra-cluster:us-west-2,192.0.2.12,canary rollout
```

sam: Storage detail: exports land in `s3://secure-exports/<job-id>/` with server-side encryption and ACL restricted to the requestor + approvers. Default lifecycle for exports is 30d; extend via ticket. Exports are rate-limited to avoid large scans.

marta: Also adding: do NOT share exports over email. Use the secure link from the export job UI or the S3 presigned URL with MFA.

olivia: @jordan please file the SEC-EXP ticket and ping me, I'll update the runbook entry and add the approver list.

jordan: Filed SEC-EXP-1423 for 90d export for legal, requested unredacted IPs for investigation, tagged @marta @sam :eyes:

marta: Acknowledged — will review and request Legal sign-off.

sam: once approved I'll kick off the one-time export and post the secure link here.

jordan: great, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
